issue.title: just check _lint-test-waits fails on provider_drain_e2e sleeps missing pragmas
issue.description: The required just check run fails deterministically in tools/check_test_wait_helpers. It reports fixed-sleep-missing-pragma at tests/fakey/test_provider_drain_e2e.py:65 and :86. This turn's diff only split agent-launch wire tests and updated related metadata, with no edits to tests/fakey/test_provider_drain_e2e.py. Fix by replacing the fixed sleeps with observable waits or adding inline '# sase-test-wait: <reason>' pragmas that explain why each positive literal sleep is required.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static lint over source text: reproduced on repeated just check runs on the same tree, fails before pytest runtime, and names fixed missing-pragma source locations rather than a timing-sensitive assertion.

evidence.note: Independent landing reproduction at 8eabf9ecf: tools/check_test_wait_helpers exits 1 at tests/fakey/test_provider_drain_e2e.py:65,86, fixed-sleep-missing-pragma. Same proposals as sase-yy.8.5 note #1 and sase-yy.8.4 note #2. Source-only lint is deterministic; this audit changed no provider-drain code.

payload.description: Both were introduced by 63a5dbef1; restart mutation audit and provider-drain wait pragmas need distinct fixture repairs.
